sources.entry: Lyrion Music Server - Server software which controls a wide range of Squeezebox/Slim Devices audio players and compatible hardware (formerly Logitech Media Server). (Source Code, Clients) GPL-2.0 deb/Docker/Perl

summary.one_liner: Lyrion Music Server (LMS) is a Perl-based streaming audio server that powers Logitech/Squeezebox players and compatible software clients such as Squeezelite.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes LMS as the server software for Squeezebox-family audio players, including Squeezebox 3rd Generation, Boom, Receiver, Transporter, Squeezebox2, and SLIMP3, plus software emulators such as Squeezelite and SqueezePlay. With plugins, it can stream a local music collection, content from many music services, and internet radio stations to players. It is written in Perl and is said to run on any platform Perl supports, including Linux, macOS, Solaris and Windows. The README names Raspberry Pi, desktops, laptops and NAS devices as examples of hardware it can run on. Installation instructions are in the separate Getting Started documentation, which the README links to but does not reproduce.
use_cases: stream local music library to Squeezebox players
run a home audio server for network music players
play internet radio on Squeezebox devices
stream music services through plugins to players
host a music server on a Raspberry Pi or NAS
how_to_run: Go to the Getting Started documentation for installation instructions (linked from the README; no commands given in the README).
notable: Successor to Logitech Media Server, SlimServer, SqueezeCenter and SqueezeboxServer, with many former names listed
Extensible through plugins for music services and internet radio
Runs on Linux, macOS, Solaris and Windows wherever Perl runs
Works with Squeezebox hardware and software emulators like Squeezelite
caveats: Designed for Squeezebox-family players; the README does not describe use with other players
Installation details are not in the README and are deferred to external documentation
keywords: stream my music library at home
